name: shiksha-admin-assignments-tutorial
title: Manage student course access

chapters.caption: 01  Find Demo Learner in the isolated, synthetic directory.
02  Open Assign Students and choose Electricity Basics.
03  Filter the roster; filters alone do not change assignments.
04  Select this learner and review the unsaved, course-specific change.
05  Confirm with Save assignments and read the saved result.
06  Verify the directory result, then reopen the persisted roster.

description: Use the actual User Directory and Assign Students dialog to find a synthetic learner, review a course-specific selection, explicitly save it, and verify the directory and reopened roster. Other course assignments are preserved; no production access is changed.

verification.productionSecurity: Not assessed; authentication and APIs are local browser-test fixtures.

courseChatStarters.reason: The native admin dashboard does not have course-chat starters.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
